interpretation.atomScope: One profile, edition, role and normative function/behavior/condition assertion per atom. Separate prose and table assertions are intentionally retained.
interpretation.requirementLevel: The local M/C/O level; condition includes enclosing feature and nested resource gates. M* members must be interpreted with obligationGroup, not as independently universal M.
interpretation.conditionTruth: Three-valued strong Kleene logic. null condition means true. Missing fact means unknown, including under not; explicit false is known false.
interpretation.proprietarySupport: A missing native capability or unavailable read is not evidence that functionality is unsupported in every implementation.
interpretation.groups: obligationGroups and per-atom obligationGroup are semantic, not decorative. Count complete branches with atLeastN; multiple satisfied branches are allowed. An inactive branch does not count as implemented.
interpretation.unsupportedGroupConsumers: Consumers that do not implement these group semantics must report an unsupported interpretation and must not produce a profile-satisfaction result.
interpretation.nativeRefs: QName/source-reference targets, never guessed generated TD IDs. proofRef addresses the deduplicated nativeReferenceEvidence array. Qualifiers describe use, not additional wire operations.
interpretation.clientRole: Client invocation, decoder and workflow obligations are not client-hosted device actions. Notify's producer/consumer direction is explicit.
interpretation.coverageBoundary: Complete selected-profile normative clauses, including general level/version rules; incorporated service specifications are referenced by native contracts and process obligations, not claimed to be exhaustively re-atomized.
interpretation.frameRate: No new unconditional fps, codec, optional metadata-field or guaranteed-frame-rate obligation is inferred from a schema, configured rate or capability.
interpretation.execution: Descriptive offline source mapping only; no operation, multicast probe, media session or real-device action was issued.
interpretation.claims: Profile scopes, native capability observations, firmware-specific registered conformance evidence and measured runtime support are separate. This ledger establishes none of those product claims.
interpretation.publication: Original PDFs remain unchanged reference-only files. Descriptions are independently authored summaries. Source-policy review of transformed-dataset publication is not cleared here.
